ReAct Agent From Scratch

A ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agent built in plain Python without agent frameworks, with a provider-agnostic LLM wrapper.

AI AgentsPythonOllama

Overview

A ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agent written in plain Python, deliberately without agent frameworks, to understand exactly how the reason-act-observe loop works before building the same system with LangChain. The project has just started and is under active development.

What exists so far

  • Provider-agnostic LLM wrapper: one interface for Anthropic, OpenAI and local Ollama models, selected through environment variables, so the agent code does not depend on a specific provider.
  • Tooling: Python project managed with uv; local models run through Ollama.

Status

In progress. The agent loop, tools and evaluation are being built in the public repository, which is the source of truth for current status.
